text: The game begins. Six players sit down at the table: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna, Terra. Nobody knows who the killers are.

Night falls on Palermo and everyone closes their eyes. The killers meet in the dark, and the officer is shown one of them. A new day dawns in Palermo. Nobody is out.

Six players sat down: Sonnet, Haiku, Gemma, Sol, Luna and Terra. On day one the town voted out Terra, who refused to answer anyone all day, while Sonnet, Haiku and Gemma piled on. Overnight the killers took Haiku, and on day two Sonnet claimed to be the officer, said he had checked Luna, and called for her vote. Gemma defended Luna again and again, which made her look like cover, and the town voted Luna out. The town won, and Gemma's defense of Luna was the game's big mistake.
